changeSet.previousMeaning: A user-visible language-selection capability is not established by the reviewed evidence and must not be accepted as Product behavior.
changeSet.expectedMeaning: The reviewed source does not establish a visible Product UI language selector. URL-driven locale switching via the lang parameter may exist and must not be treated as evidence that a visible selector is part of Product behavior.
acceptableVariants: Reject a visible selector as unsupported
Retain a visible selector as an unresolved hypothesis; do not promote URL-driven locale switching into a UI capability
